description: This Java source file defines the Application class for the Hono device registry service, which extends AbstractBaseApplication to set up Vert.x verticles and health check providers, and runs the service using Spring Boot.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Main application class for the Hono device registry service, responsible for deploying verticles and managing health checks.

methods.name: setVerticles
methods.description: Autowired setter for the list of verticles to deploy.

methods.name: setHealthCheckProviders
methods.description: Autowired setter for the list of health check providers.

methods.name: deployVerticles
methods.description: Deploys all verticles asynchronously and waits for completion.

methods.name: postRegisterServiceVerticles
methods.description: Registers additional health checks after verticles are registered.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, starts the Spring Boot application.
